answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 30043 Country: India Title: My Sister & her husband; My brother & his wife will be performing Hajj this year. Can I send my wife with them to perform Hajj? Question: Assalamu Alaikkum. Insha Allah My Sister & her husband; My brother & his wife will be performing Hajj this year. Can I send my wife with them to perform Hajj? Kindly reply in English. Answer ID: 30043 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 470/322/H=1432) It is not lawful to send her with them. According to Shariah, your brother and brother-in-law are not mahram for your wife. It is wajib for a woman to accompany her husband or a mahram in hajj journey. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
